// Callable function index (Dumper-7)
//
// Reflected UFunctions that can be invoked via ProcessEvent, with the exact parameter
// layout needed to build the call buffer.
//
// Calling the game's own function is often SAFER than writing memory directly: the
// engine's side effects still run (replication, delegates, animation, audio). Writing a
// replicated value by hand can desync a client that calling the setter would not.
//
// Usage sketch:
//     struct { float NewHealth; } Params{ 100.0f };   // offsets from the table below
//     Component->ProcessEvent(Fn, &Params);
//
// ExecOffset is module-relative - useful for a breakpoint or a direct native call.
// Functions taking containers/delegates/interfaces are EXCLUDED rather than guessed at;
// a wrong buffer corrupts the stack. See the exclusion counts in the summary.
//
// This file is reflection-only: nothing here was called, and no live memory was read.

 [1] SUMMARY
=====================================================================
Callable functions       : 17289
  on game classes        : 8488
  on engine classes      : 8801
High-interest matches    : 254   (full detail in section [2])

Excluded (not callable / not layoutable):
  delegate signatures    : 1032
  ubergraphs/scaffolding : 718
  unsupported parameters : 4102

=====================================================================
 [2] HIGH-INTEREST FUNCTIONS  (gameplay verbs on game classes)
=====================================================================
